_readme: Hand-maintained event facts. npm run event merges this with what it reads from data/luma-events into src/data/event.json. live=false keeps the Event tab out of the nav (the routes still open, with a preview banner). activeGames lists minigame keys confirmed for this event; once live, only those show. sourceEvent names the event the luma-events code at data/luma-events.commit was written for; while it differs from name, the pages say the numbers come from that event's code.
name: Lumaween 2026
